description: Defines the 'Section' class in the MigraDoc library, representing a document section with headers, footers, elements, and serialization methods.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section in a document, managing headers, footers, elements, and serialization.

classes.name: Section.SectionValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for the Section class.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Section object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation for the Section object.

methods.name: PreviousSection
methods.description: Returns the previous section in the parent collection, if any.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the section, optionally with text and style.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Adds a chart to the section, with optional type.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Adds a table to the section.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the section.

methods.name: AddTextFrame
methods.description: Adds a text frame to the section.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds existing Paragraph, Chart, Table, Image, or TextFrame objects to the section.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the section into a DDL format.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the document object model.

methods.name: LastParagraph
methods.description: Retrieves the last paragraph in the section.

methods.name: LastTable
methods.description: Retrieves the last table in the section.
